_comment: Merchant directory. n=name, a=aliases (lowercase), c=canonical category ids (primary first), ap=Apple Pay accepted (true/false/'unknown'), no=networks NOT accepted, note=fine print shown to the user, online=true if this entry is a website/app rather than a physical store. Card-specific merchant rates and credits are matched by name/alias against cards.json. only=list of card ids that can be used at this merchant (issuer portals).

merchants.note: Costco warehouses and gas stations in the US accept only Visa (Discover is not accepted anywhere at Costco). Groceries bought at Costco do not count as 'supermarket' for Amex or Chase grocery bonuses (warehouse clubs are excluded).
Visa only. Codes as a gas station, so gas bonuses on Visa cards apply.
Costco.com accepts Visa and Mastercard only (Discover was dropped in Nov 2023; no American Express).
Warehouse club: excluded from supermarket bonuses on Amex and Chase.
Warehouse club: excluded from supermarket bonuses.
Walmart does not accept Apple Pay in stores. Walmart (a superstore) is excluded from Amex and Chase supermarket bonuses even for groceries.
Target is excluded from Amex and Chase supermarket bonuses even for groceries.
Amazon.com does not accept Apple Pay. Prime Visa earns its top rate here with an active Prime membership.
Prime Visa counts Amazon Fresh at its Amazon rate. Amex and Chase may not treat Amazon Fresh as a supermarket.
Counts as a US supermarket for Amex, and as a Whole Foods purchase for Prime Visa.
Kroger-family stores began accepting Apple Pay in 2025.
WinCo historically accepts only Visa and debit; verify at your store.
Coding varies; some locations code as a warehouse/general store rather than a supermarket.

Instacart orders usually code as the grocery store or as Instacart itself. Amex does not treat Instacart as a US supermarket; Chase grocery bonuses may or may not apply. Expect the base rate unless the charge codes as the store.
Pay in the Uber app. Apple Card earns its partner rate only when you pay with Apple Pay inside the app. Amex Uber Cash must be added to your Uber account first.
Uber Eats orders generally code as restaurants (Amex Gold 4x, Freedom Unlimited 3%). Amex Uber Cash applies to Uber Eats too.

Freedom Unlimited earns 2% total on Lyft (through Sept 30, 2027; the old 5% ended March 2025). Bilt Palladium earns 4x when Bilt is linked as the loyalty partner in the Lyft app. Bilt Cash can cover $10 of Lyft per month.
Generally codes as restaurants.
Generally codes as restaurants. Amex Gold's $10 monthly dining credit covers Grubhub/Seamless; Bilt Cash can cover $10 of Grubhub per month.
Removed from the Amex Gold monthly dining credit on July 1, 2026.
Removed from the Amex Gold monthly dining credit on July 1, 2026.
Loading the Starbucks app card usually codes as a restaurant too.
Amex Gold has a monthly Dunkin' credit (enrollment required).
No longer an Apple Card partner (removed Feb 2025).
Covered by the Amex Gold monthly dining credit.
Covered by the Amex Gold monthly dining credit.
Amex Platinum and Amex Gold Resy credits apply at US restaurants on Resy (enrollment required; pay with the card at the restaurant).
Since Sept 15, 2026 select US Tock venues showing the 'Resy Credit eligible' badge count toward the Amex Platinum and Amex Gold Resy credits (enrollment required; pay with the card).
Chevron/Texaco are not Apple Card partners (only Exxon and Mobil are).
Apple Card partner: 3% with Apple Pay at Exxon- and Mobil-branded pumps via the Exxon Mobil Rewards+ app or contactless at the pump.
Arco stations may charge a fee for credit cards or accept debit only at some pumps.
Billed through your Tesla account; codes vary between 'electric vehicle charging' and 'automotive'. Wells Fargo Autograph counts EV charging with gas; Amex and Chase gas bonuses usually do not.
Codes as passenger rail: counts as transit on Amex Blue Cash Preferred and as travel on most travel cards.
United is your selected airline for the Amex Platinum airline fee credit (incidentals such as seat fees, bags, and some purchases; not airfare).

merchants.n: International airlines (ANA, JAL, Cathay, EVA, Korean, Singapore, Lufthansa, BA, Air France, KLM, Emirates, Qatar, Turkish, Air Canada)
merchants.note: Booking directly with a foreign airline counts as 'airline' for Amex Platinum 5x and Amex Gold 3x. Watch foreign transaction fees on Freedom Unlimited and Blue Cash Preferred if billed in a foreign currency.

Book directly with Marriott (marriott.com or the app) to earn the Boundless card's Marriott rate plus base Bonvoy points and elite bonuses. Third-party bookings do not earn Bonvoy points or elite nights.
Bilt points transfer to World of Hyatt 1:1; consider paying with the card whose points you want and transferring Bilt points for award stays.
Many luxury independents are bookable through Amex Fine Hotels + Resorts / The Hotel Collection (Platinum hotel credit) or Bilt Travel (Palladium hotel credit).
Airbnb codes as travel/lodging: earns Wells Fargo Autograph 3x travel and Bilt 2x, but does NOT count as a hotel for Amex Gold or Platinum bonus rates.
Codes as travel; not a hotel for Amex bonus categories.

Online travel agencies code as 'travel', not as airlines or hotels: Amex Platinum/Gold airline and hotel bonus rates do not apply, and hotel stays booked here usually earn no hotel loyalty points or elite credit. Wells Fargo Autograph (3x travel) and Bilt (2x + Bilt Cash) still earn.
Apple Card partner: 3% with Apple Pay in the Booking.com app. Codes as travel, not hotel, for Amex.
Online travel agencies code as travel (not airline/hotel) for Amex. Google Flights and Kayak hand you off to the airline or an agency; check who actually charges the card.
Only Chase cards earn the portal bonus (Freedom Unlimited 5%, Prime Visa 5%). Hotels booked through portals usually don't earn hotel elite credit.
Platinum: 5x on flights and prepaid hotels booked here, and the hotel credit applies to Fine Hotels + Resorts and The Hotel Collection prepaid bookings. Gold: 3x flights, 2x prepaid hotels.
Bilt Palladium's hotel credit is used on Bilt Travel hotel bookings.

merchants.n: Avis / National / Enterprise / Budget / Sixt / Alamo / Thrifty / Dollar
merchants.note: Decline the rental company's collision damage waiver to use card coverage. Primary coverage (pays before your own insurance) beats secondary. Coverage typically excludes trucks, exotic cars, some countries, and rentals over 15 to 30 days.
Peer-to-peer rentals like Turo are usually EXCLUDED from card rental car coverage. Buy Turo's protection plan.
Netflix bills your card directly (no Apple Pay).
Check whether an Amex Platinum digital entertainment credit or a Blue Cash Preferred credit currently covers this service.

merchants.n: Apple Music / Apple TV+ / Apple One / iCloud+
merchants.note: Apple services billed by Apple earn Apple Card's Apple rate. They also count as streaming for Blue Cash Preferred and Wells Fargo Autograph.
Check the Amex Platinum digital entertainment credit's current eligible list.
Prime membership fees are generally excluded from Amex streaming bonuses; Prime Video Channels may code as Amazon.
Codes as Amazon for Prime Visa; Audible is on the Amex Blue Cash Preferred streaming list.

merchants.n: New York Times / Wall Street Journal (digital)
merchants.note: Check the Amex Platinum digital entertainment credit's current eligible list.
Paying your bill with a card that has cell phone protection activates that coverage. Some carriers charge a fee or withhold autopay discounts for credit cards; compare the discount with the rewards.
AT&T's autopay discount is lower for credit cards than for bank drafts on many plans; weigh the discount against rewards and cell phone protection.
No longer an Apple Card partner (removed July 2025). T-Mobile's autopay discount may require a debit card or bank account.

merchants.n: Mint Mobile / Visible / Google Fi / Cricket / Boost / US Mobile
merchants.note: Most MVNOs code as telecommunications, which counts as a phone plan for Wells Fargo Autograph and for cell phone protection.
Apple Card partner: 3% with Apple Pay. Bilt Palladium earns 3x in-store (4x on Walgreens-brand items, +100 points per prescription) when linked. Bilt Cash can cover $10 at Walgreens per month.

Apple Card earns 3% on Apple purchases and 0% APR Apple Card Monthly Installments on eligible devices. Weigh that against purchase protection and extended warranty on Amex cards for big-ticket devices.
Apple Card partner: 3% with Apple Pay in the Nike app, nike.com, or Nike stores.
Amex Platinum has a quarterly lululemon credit (US stores and lululemon.com, enrollment required, outlets excluded).
The Amex Platinum Saks credit ended July 1, 2026.
Apple Card partner: 3% with Apple Pay at participating Ace stores and acehardware.com.
May be billed by a foreign merchant: foreign transaction fees can apply on Freedom Unlimited and Blue Cash Preferred even in US dollars.

merchants.n: Zara / H&M / Uniqlo / Gap / Old Navy
Dollar Tree / Five Below / Dollar General
GameStop / Steam / PlayStation Store / Nintendo eShop / Xbox
Disneyland / Disney World / Universal / Six Flags

merchants.note: Amex Platinum has an annual Equinox credit (enrollment required).
Bilt has fitness partnerships (e.g., SoulCycle) that award extra Bilt points when linked.

merchants.n: Planet Fitness / 24 Hour Fitness / LA Fitness / Crunch

merchants.note: Most utilities charge a convenience fee for credit card payments (often $1 to $3 per payment or ~2%). If the fee exceeds the rewards, pay from a bank account instead.

merchants.n: Comcast Xfinity / Spectrum / AT&T Internet / Sonic
merchants.note: Internet and cable are not 'streaming' or 'phone plan' for bonus purposes. Xfinity and some others reduce autopay discounts for credit cards.
Convenience fees are common; compare with rewards.

merchants.n: Car insurance (Geico, Progressive, State Farm, Allstate, Farmers)
merchants.note: Insurance earns base rates everywhere. No fee at most insurers.

Pay rent through the Bilt app with the Bilt card — no fee. Under your Flexible Bilt Cash option, rent earns 0 points unless you redeem Bilt Cash at checkout ($3 per 100 points, max 1 point per $1). Other cards would pay ~3% through rent portals, which wipes out any rewards.
Bilt supports mortgage payments for Bilt cardholders; other cards generally cannot pay mortgages without a fee.
IRS processors charge about 1.75% to 1.9% for credit cards. Only worthwhile with a card earning more than that, or to hit a spending bonus.
Many government agencies add a credit card surcharge.
Amex Platinum reimburses Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fees and has an annual CLEAR Plus credit (enrollment may be required).
Schools and daycares often add a 2% to 3% card fee; check first.

merchants.n: PayPal / Venmo / Cash App / Zelle (sending money)
merchants.note: Sending money to a person with a credit card costs ~3% on Venmo/PayPal and may post as a cash advance on some cards. Use a bank account instead. PayPal checkout at a merchant is fine and codes as that merchant.
Gift card purchases are excluded from most bonus categories and from most credits. Amazon gift cards do not earn the Prime Visa 5%.
Amex Platinum has an Oura credit (check the current amount, period, and enrollment rules).
Amex Platinum reimburses the Walmart+ monthly membership (enrollment required; taxes and Plus Up excluded).
Amex Platinum reimburses an auto-renewing Uber One membership paid with the card.
Costco Travel accepts only Visa.

merchants.n: Hotel booked on Marriott.com for someone else / Marriott gift cards
merchants.note: Gift card purchases are usually excluded from bonus earning.

Outside the US: Freedom Unlimited (3%) and Blue Cash Preferred (2.7%) charge foreign transaction fees. Discover has limited acceptance abroad; Amex is accepted less than Visa/Mastercard. Amex Gold/Platinum bonus categories are US-only for restaurants/supermarkets, but flights on foreign airlines still earn the airline rate.

Apple Card partner: 3% with Apple Pay for rentals booked on Hertz.com or in the Hertz app at US corporate locations (≤61 days). Amex Platinum gives Hertz President's Circle status; Amex Gold gives Five Star. Decline Hertz's damage waiver to use card coverage.
Apple Card partner: 3% with Apple Pay in the ChargePoint app at public stations. Wells Fargo Autograph counts EV charging as fuel (3x).
Covered by the Amex Gold monthly dining credit (added April 2026).
Covered by the Amex Gold monthly dining credit (added April 2026).
Amazon-owned: Prime Visa earns its Amazon rate here.
Prime Visa earns its Amazon rate when paying with Amazon Pay.
Bilt Palladium earns 3x at Metropolis drive-up garages when your Metropolis account is linked (airport, event, municipal and hospital lots excluded).
Amex Platinum and Blue Cash Preferred: 10% back on concessions at participating venues, up to $250/yr, enrollment required (offer ends Dec 31, 2026).

merchants.n: Fine Hotels + Resorts / The Hotel Collection (Amex Travel)
merchants.note: Amex Platinum: 5x and the $300 semiannual hotel credit on prepaid FHR (any length) or THC (2+ nights) bookings. Amex Gold: 5x on prepaid hotels plus a $100 on-property credit at THC stays of 2+ nights.
